description.en: The ID of the backup set.

description.zh:
跨阿里云账号主账号角色名，即备份集所属阿里云账号下的RAM角色。 
>该参数仅在跨阿里云账号备份时填写。
description.en:
The RAM role name of the backup set owner's Alibaba Cloud account.

> Specify this parameter only when backing up across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh:
跨阿里云主账号，即备份集所属的阿里云主账号。 
>该参数仅在跨阿里云账号备份时填写。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the backup set owner.

> Specify this parameter only when backing up across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh:
数仓版集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查询目标地域下数仓版集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

> Call [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) to list cluster IDs in a region.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。
description.en: The end time of the query. It must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ.

description.zh: 页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer数据类型最大值的正整数。默认值：1。
description.en: The page number. Valid values: positive integers greater than 0 and no larger than the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: 1.

The number of entries per page. Valid values:

- **30** (default)

- **50**

- **100**

description.zh:
地域ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~143074~~)接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID.

> Call [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) to list supported regions and zones for AnalyticDB for MySQL, including region IDs.
The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-backups --db-cluster-id am-bp18934i73vb50000 --backup-id 327320000 --start-time 2022-06-01T16:00Z --end-time 2022-06-02T16:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --cross-uid 1950000 --cross-role role-for-xxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
